title: McFarlane NBA 6 Yao Ming vs Shaquille O’Neal 2 Pack Figures Rockets Lakers
descriptionText: The McFarlane NBA 6 Yao Ming vs Shaquille O’Neal 2 Pack Figures is a collectible set of action figures depicting two iconic basketball players. This set is based on the Space Jam movie and features characters from the film, specifically Yao Ming and Shaquille O’Neal. The figures are made of plastic and stand at 6 inches tall, with a scale of 1:12. The figures come in a multicolor design and include a basketball as part of the set. This collectible is an original release from McFarlane Toys in 2004, capturing the essence of the basketball-themed movie and sports franchise.
